    --- All glyphs in visual order.
    function glyphs(self): { Glyph }

    --- Iterates the glyphs in visual order: `for _, glyph in line do`.
    function __iter(self): ((TextLine, number) -> (number?, Glyph), TextLine, number)
end

--- Shapes and lays out styled runs of text with the runtime's shaper, so
--- scripts get real line breaking and bidirectional ordering. Append runs,
--- set the box, then draw it in one call or walk its lines and glyphs to draw
--- them yourself. Codepoint indices are 1 based like `utf8.offset`.
--- ```lua
--- type Label = {
---   text: Text,
---   paint: Paint,
--- }
---
--- function init(self: Label, context: Context): boolean
---   local font = context:font('IBM Plex Sans Arabic')
---   self.text:append('مرحبا بالعالم', { font = font, size = 32, paint = self.paint })
---   self.text.sizing = 'fixed'
---   self.text.maxWidth = 240
---   self.text.align = 'start'
---   return true
--- end
---
--- function draw(self: Label, renderer: Renderer)
---   self.text:draw(renderer)
--- end
--- ```
declare extern type Text with
    sizing: TextSizing
    overflow: TextOverflow
    align: TextAlign
    wrap: TextWrap
    wordBreak: TextWordBreak
    origin: TextOrigin
    direction: TextDirection
    --- Wrap width when sizing is not 'autoWidth'.
    maxWidth: number
    --- Height the text overflows at when sizing is 'fixed'.
    maxHeight: number
    --- Space between paragraphs separated by a newline.
    paragraphSpacing: number
    --- Number of codepoints appended.
    read length: number
    read isEmpty: boolean
    read lineCount: number

    --- Appends a styled run. Runs join into one string; a newline starts a paragraph.
    function append(self, text: string, style: TextRunStyle): ()

    --- Removes every run.
    function clear(self): ()

    --- Draws every run with its own paint, or all of them with the given paint.
    function draw(self, renderer: Renderer, paint: Paint?): ()

    --- Minimum and maximum corner of the laid out text.
    function bounds(self): (Vector, Vector)

    --- The line at a 1 based index, top to bottom.
    function line(self, index: number): TextLine

    --- Every line, top to bottom.
    function lines(self): { TextLine }

    --- The codepoint index nearest a point in the text's local space.
    function hitTest(self, position: Vector): number

    --- The caret before the codepoint at index: its x, top and bottom. Nil when the text is empty.
    function caret(self, index: number): (number, number, number)

    --- Rectangles covering the codepoints from one index to another, one per glyph.
    function selectionRects(self, from: number, to: number): { { min: Vector, max: Vector } }

```luau
--- Represents a vector with three components. Vectors created with
--- `Vector.xy` have z = 0. All magnitude and interpolation operations
--- (`length`, `dot`, `distance`, `normalized`, `lerp`, ...) use all three
--- components; with z = 0 they behave exactly as 2D math.
declare extern type Vector with

    --- The x component of the vector (read-only).
    --- ```lua
    --- local v = Vector.xy(10, -5)
    --- local xValue = v.x  -- 10
    --- ```
    x: number

    --- The y component of the vector (read-only).
    --- ```lua
    --- local v = Vector.xy(10, -5)
    --- local yValue = v.y  -- -5
    --- ```
    y: number

    --- The z component of the vector (read-only). Zero for vectors created
    --- with `Vector.xy`; populated by 3D APIs that return a `Vector`.
    --- ```lua
    --- local v = m:transformPoint(1, 2, 3)
    --- local zValue = v.z
    --- ```
    z: number

    -- Provides indexed access to the vector components: [1] = x, [2] = y,
    -- [3] = z.
    -- ```lua
    -- local v = Vector.xy(3, 4)
    -- print(v[1], v[2]) -- 3 4
    -- ```
    [number]: number

    --- Returns the length of the vector.
    @[deprecated{ use = "Vector.length" }]
    function length(self): number

    --- Returns the squared length of the vector.
    --- ```lua
    --- local v = Vector.xy(3, 4)
    --- local len2 = v:lengthSquared()  -- 25
    --- ```
    @[deprecated{ use = "Vector.lengthSquared" }]
    function lengthSquared(self): number

    --- Returns a normalized copy of the vector. If the length is zero,
    --- the result is the zero vector.
    --- ```lua
    --- local v = Vector.xy(10, 0)
    --- local n = v:normalized()  -- 1 0
    --- ```
    @[deprecated{ use = "Vector.normalized" }]
    function normalized(self): Vector

    --- Returns true if the two vectors have equal components.
    --- ```lua
    --- local a = Vector.xy(1, 2)
    --- local b = Vector.xy(1, 2)
    --- local c = Vector.xy(2, 1)
    --- print(a == b)  -- true
    --- print(a == c)  -- false
    --- ```
    function __eq(self, rhs: Vector): boolean

    --- Returns the negated vector.
    --- ```lua
    --- local v = Vector.xy(2, -3)
    --- local neg = -v   -- -2 3
    --- ```
    function __unm(self): Vector

    --- Returns the sum of two vectors.
    --- ```lua
    --- local a = Vector.xy(2, 3)
    --- local b = Vector.xy(-1, 5)
    --- local c = a + b  -- 1 8
    --- ```
    function __add(self, rhs: Vector): Vector

    --- Returns the difference between two vectors.
    --- ```lua
    --- local a = Vector.xy(2, 3)
    --- local b = Vector.xy(-1, 5)
    --- local c = a - b  -- 3 -2
    --- ```
    function __sub(self, rhs: Vector): Vector

    --- Returns the vector scaled by the given number.
    --- ```lua
    --- local v = Vector.xy(3, -2)
    --- local doubled = v * 2    -- 6 -4
    --- ```
    function __mul(self, rhs: number): Vector

    --- Returns the vector divided by the given number.
    --- ```lua
    --- local v = Vector.xy(6, -4)
    --- local half = v / 2    -- 3 -2
    --- ```
    function __div(self, rhs: number): Vector

    --- Returns the distance to the other vector.
    --- ```lua
    --- local a = Vector.xy(0, 0)
    --- local b = Vector.xy(3, 4)
    --- print(a:distance(b))  -- 5
    --- ```
    @[deprecated{ use = "Vector.distance" }]
    function distance(self, other: Vector): number

    --- Returns the squared distance to the other vector.
    --- ```lua
    --- local a = Vector.xy(0, 0)
    --- local b = Vector.xy(3, 4)
    --- print(a:distanceSquared(b))  -- 25
    --- ```
    @[deprecated{ use = "Vector.distanceSquared" }]
    function distanceSquared(self, other: Vector): number

    --- Returns the dot product of the vector and the other vector.
    --- ```lua
    --- local a = Vector.xy(1, 2)
    --- local b = Vector.xy(3, 4)
    --- print(a:dot(b))  -- 11  (1*3 + 2*4)
    --- ```
    @[deprecated{ use = "Vector.dot" }]
    function dot(self, other: Vector): number

    --- Returns the linear interpolation between the vector and the other
    --- vector, using t where 0 returns the vector and 1 returns the other.
    --- ```lua

    --- local b = Vector.xy(10, 0)
    --- local p = a:lerp(b, 0.5)  -- 5 0
    --- ```
    @[deprecated{ use = "Vector.lerp" }]
    function lerp(self, other: Vector, t:number): Vector

    --- Writes x, y, z as 12 bytes (three float32) into the buffer at

    --- ```lua
    --- local buf = buffer.create(12)
    --- Vector.xyz(1, 2, 3):writeToBuffer(buf, 0)

    function writeToBuffer(self, buf: buffer, byteOffset: number): ()

    --- Writes x, y, z, w as 16 bytes (four float32) into the buffer at

    --- lightDir:writeVec4(ubo, 0, 0)  -- w = 0 for a direction

    function writeVec4(self, buf: buffer, byteOffset: number, w: number): ()
end

    --- Creates a vector with the specified x and y components.

    --- Returns the cross product of two vectors (z-component of the 3D cross product).

    --- Returns the 3D cross product of two vectors.

    cross3: @checked (a: Vector, b: Vector) -> Vector,

    --- Returns a + b * scale.

    --- Returns the linear interpolation from one vector to another, using t

    --- Returns the length of the given vector.

    length: @checked (v: Vector) -> number,

    --- Returns the squared length of the given vector.
    --- ```lua

}
